name: Pokhmelye s podvokhom
source:
The meeting with the beauty in the bar ends with a hangover morning, which takes an unexpected turn. Protagonist involved in the confrontation of powerful creatures from the other world.​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
酒吧里与绝色美人的邂逅，在次日清晨的宿醉中迎来了意想不到的转折——主角自此被卷入了异界强大生物之间的激烈交锋。

[摘自F95Zone]
